name: Imhotep

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Are you heading out, Professor? Or do you want to stay with me a little longer?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Being with the animals feels really nice.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: The little kittens and puppies fight over their chew toys every evening.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Oh, it's already midnight? Why are you still here, Professor? Got something to tell me?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: "We want more treats!" they say... Hmm, the puppies seem unhappy. Professor, will you approve their request?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Since I've been living with animals for so long, it's only natural for me to see you as a little pet sometimes... Right, Professor?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: You look so cute in your sleep. I wish I could watch you forever.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: The little ones in the Oasis seem to feel unwell... I'm going to check on them. Would you come along with me?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hehehe...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Teehee, your eyes are adorable.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Need my help?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Now, how are you going to return the favor?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Hi, I'm Imhotep. I mostly take care of animals, but I'm also fine with people too.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Hehehe... My understanding of animal language has improved.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Living with animals is a great experience. Besides, animals will never betray you.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Everything has a soul of their own. To actually have control over their souls, though... That is something only humans and Dolls can do.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: I am ready.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Let's go.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Don't worry, it will be over soon.

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: That was hardly a challenge.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: You're safe now.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Is this the end of me...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Before this oath of ours, there were many things that happened... many unforgettable memories... From now onwards, let's make some new memories together... Fufufu...

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: As a special New Year's treat, I'm doubling the food for the kittens, puppies and lambs today. But... cleaning up afterwards is going to be a whole lot of trouble. Professor, will you lend me a hand? Of course, I'll return the favor... hehehe...

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: This Maine Coon is so beautiful, right? Its fur and eye colors are simply perfect, and its body is oh-so soft to the touch. Today is Valentine's Day, right? Besides this kitten, I have other wonderful gifts prepared for you today...

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: I'm a veterinarian, but I've never taken care of aquatic animals before. That being said, nothing's stopping us from dropping by the fish pond to enjoy the scenery together on Tanabata, right? Yes, of course, we're heading there together.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: I was planning on making a chocolate pie, but dogs can't eat chocolate, so I changed it to a pumpkin pie... though isn't this more suitable for the Halloween atmosphere? Fufufu, I've put something special in the pie, so please look forward to it.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Put a Santa hat on this Coton de Tulear and now it's our Santa Claus. Speaking of which, Professor... Want to have a drink with me before starting this game? It's hot buttered rum.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text:
It's your birthday, so it's only natural that I've prepared something for such a special occasion.
Here, I bought you a bell to hang around your neck.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
To me, living among animals feels much better than with humans.
Animals are easy to raise and they have simple minds. Seeing them grow up little by little always makes me feel accomplished.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
In my spare time, I help those who work in animal husbandry and agriculture.
Their lives depend on the well-being of livestock, and a seemingly insignificant issue could ruin an entire year's worth of hard work. Perhaps I'm only helping them out of a sense of responsibility.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
This black goat is called Niggurath. I found her in the woods half a year ago when I rescued her.
Usually she is quite gentle, but sometimes her eyes turn red.
What happened, Professor? You look so pale after hearing her name, and your limbs are trembling too... Hehehe, you're so cute. It makes me want to bully you a little.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: Niggurath gave birth to many babies today. Every one of them was full of energy. Her newborn kids were bare and still hadn't opened their eyes... The thought of witnessing their growth makes me happy.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Honestly, Professor, you remind me of a little animal.
Hehehe... So, would you like to try experiencing what the animals feel? It won't take you long...
Oh, there's no need to be afraid. It's okay, it may hurt, but I'll be gentle...

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehehe.

career:
The UL-VET is a high-end veterinary Doll developed by Ultimate Life. Compared to veterinary Dolls designed for work in cities, the UL-VET series possess all currently known zoology knowledge, including that of endangered species. They are also equipped with an extremely expensive and effective self-learning module.

Imhotep was originally produced to serve as a pet physician for the upper class. Later, a mysterious figure arranged for her to be gifted to the Endangered Species Conservation Society for their 70th Anniversary. After working for several years, she joined Project Neural Cloud as the top-class representative of the society.
infoStories:
Imhotep's first job was acting as an expatriate sent by Ultimate Life to Palau. She was responsible for serving clients in the surrounding Pacific Island countries. 

Imhotep didn't care much for the job. She, of course, loves animals very much, regardless of their rarity, but she couldn't stand the people who locked them in small courtyard cages and treated them as if they were just pleasing scenery.

They became collectors' items—mere backdrops used to flaunt a family's wealth. They weren't considered a living, thinking creature with their own will. They were stripped of their dignity, made to become ornaments formed from flesh and blood. 

Still, Imhotep understood that this was also a way for animals to survive. The animals running free outside of confinement might be closer to nature, but they also faced constant dangers. Imhotep neither had the qualifications nor the right to definitively answer what kind of life was best for them.

With the help of a previous client, Imhotep successfully left her previous position and was presented as a commemorative gift from Ultimate Life to the Endangered Species Conservation Society.

Although her new position holds none of the comforts found in Palau, and the work is more strenuous, requiring her to stay in the wilderness all year round, this is the type of life that Imhotep enjoys. A place where she can witness rescued birds soar off into the sky and rescued animals bound off into the wilderness. Here, there are no reinforced concrete walls, or people crowding around, pointing and staring.

In the wilderness, Imhotep has had ample opportunity to make new friends. Many rescued animals are well-accustomed to her presence and, if they're not currently on their seasonal migration, they will often visit her hut to play and eat—just like a family. 

Over time, she learned to exchange information with animals and understand their needs and emotions. Many of her colleagues attempted to learn from Imhotep and reproduce this inexplicable talent. Even if they couldn't learn it, they could at least put forth a systematic theory for experts to research, but in the end, all their efforts were for naught.

"... I can't find any commonalities. Every movement and sound that Imhotep uses are all different, but the animals can somehow still understand what she wants to express. I think this process is beyond the scope of current scientific understanding. I recommend that the association leave this one unexplained for the time being."
—Professor Akane's Report, Animal Behaviorist from the Endangered Species Conservation Society.

Imhotep's friend circle is not limited to wild animals, but also includes some animal-loving photographers and wilderness explorers. As she treated more animals and met more people, her reputation gradually spread. This, unfortunately, eventually led to trouble finding her as well.

It was a special operation. Imhotep was forced to pretend to be a human veterinarian to lure a group of poachers to kidnap her. Then, working from the inside, she helped Interpol close in and apprehend the group as well as rescue dozens of endangered animals.

"... According to publicly available information, Imhotep only took half a month to gain the trust of the poachers' leader and at the same time got two mid-level leaders to desert the cause. This was not mentioned in the report provided by Ultimate Life and the Endangered Species Conservation Society, but I believe this should be considered."
—Project Neural Cloud Doll Preliminary Screening 3rd Round

Imhotep was elected by the Endangered Species Conservation Society to join Project Neural Cloud. Both the society's administrator and Imhotep herself hoped they could use the platform to master new knowledge and technology, or use the resources it provided to aid medical research. After all, a veterinarian's purview is not purely centered around animals, they must also study diseases that could be transmitted from animals to humans.

Imhotep didn't express much emotion after being stranded in the cloud. She just kept methodically plugging away at her work, as if this was all just a minor interlude for her. 

Only a few like the Professor and Persicaria were perceptive enough to see the slight changes in Imhotep's demeanor that indicated that all was not as it seemed. Persicaria asked if she wanted a private psychological consultation, but Imhotep declined.

"I'm fine, Persicaria. Maybe I just need some time to adjust..."
"Hehe, if you're really worried about it, it'd be better to ask the Professor to free up some time in their schedule. These kids really want to meet them."
—Doll Conversation Recording
oathDesc: Who's a good kid? Yes, that's you~

projections.name: Surgeon
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"War has not only brought suffering to mankind, but to all the living beings on Earth. But who has ever reflected on it?"

"War has not only brought suffering to mankind, but to all the living beings on Earth. But who has ever reflected on it?"

projections.name: Spiritual Healer
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Humans are essentially the same as other living beings. They are all children of the earth, sharing a limited space."

skinList.name: Her Secret
skinList.desc:
[Call of Study Series]
Imhotep was not allowed to bring pets to school with her in the beginning—but no one had proof that these animals coming in through the window were her pets and not wild ones. They only listened to Imhotep, after all.

skinList.name: Day of Reincarnation
skinList.desc: The first awakening of Doll has the same level of importance as birth to a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection— "First time meeting, huh? You're saying that there's a feeling of affection here? It could only be a natural bond then... what else could it be? Hehe..."

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"Hehe, your reaction is so amusing. This perfume and the little ones' affection; please accept them both, Professor."

skinList.name: Sun-Drenched Whispers
skinList.desc:
This is a leisurely interlude on a warm, comfortable afternoon. The scattered silk and glints of gold lend an air of freshness and vitality to the austere landscape. Right now is the time for her to monopolize the sun.
"Hehe, it seems you caught me napping... Now then, why don't you come take a rest with the animals? Keep it a secret, okay?"

skinList.name: Shining Night♫Radiant Rhythm
skinList.desc:
Mysterious yet alluring, a biorhythmic melody fills the air around the stage on this starry night—thus was Nanaka's verdict on this by all means unexpected Idol as she awarded her a full score.
""When the stage is suffused in starlight, let the spirits of the world transform into a most beautiful melody.""

skinList.name: Night-melting Blossom
skinList.desc: From vibrant and lush forest paths to dust-reaved ruins, a traveler's steps carry with them faraway sounds. Memories, replicated in Magrasea with Neural Projection—""Some kickin' metal on a night with a bonfire all to ourselves. Like something right out of those old-fashioned movies—first time for both me and you, right?""
